    <style>/* =====================================================
   SRHU LIBRARY OPAC COMPLETE FONT & SPACING FIX
===================================================== */

/* ===== GLOBAL FONT ===== */

body,
html,
#opac-main-search,
.navbar,
.nav,
.card,
.card-body,
h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,
p,
span,
div,
a,
input,
button,
select,
textarea,
table,
td,
th,
li{
    font-family:"Times New Roman", Times, serif !important;
    font-size:12pt !important;
    line-height:1.2 !important;
}

/* ===== HEADINGS ===== */

h1{
    font-size:20pt !important;
}

h2{
    font-size:18pt !important;
}

h3{
    font-size:16pt !important;
}

h4{
    font-size:14pt !important;
}

/* =====================================================
   LEFT QUICK LINKS
===================================================== */

.quick-links-box{
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:12px;
    overflow:hidden;
    border:1px solid #e5e7ef;
    box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    margin-bottom:20px;
}

/* HEADER */

.quick-header{
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,#002d87,#003cb3);
    color:#fff;
    padding:14px;
    font-size:14pt !important;
    font-weight:bold;
}

/* MENU ITEMS */

.quick-item{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;

    padding:10px 12px !important;

    text-decoration:none !important;
    color:#1746b0 !important;

    border-bottom:1px solid #eceff5;

    font-size:12pt !important;
    font-weight:600;

    line-height:1.05 !important;

    white-space:normal !important;
    overflow:visible !important;
    word-break:break-word;

    transition:0.3s ease;
}

/* MENU TEXT */

.quick-item span:first-child{
    flex:1;
    display:block;
    line-height:1.05 !important;
}

/* HOVER */

.quick-item:hover{
    background:#f5f8ff;
    padding-left:16px !important;
}

/* ARROW */

.arrow{
    font-size:18px;
    color:#4f6fff;
    font-weight:bold;
    flex-shrink:0;
}

/* =====================================================
   IMPORTANT LINKS BOX
===================================================== */

.important-box{
    margin:10px;
    border:1px solid #e5e7ef;
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:8px 10px !important;
    background:#fafbff;
}

/* IMPORTANT TITLE */

.important-box h4{
    color:#1746b0;
    margin-bottom:4px !important;
    font-size:10pt !important;
    line-height:1 !important;
}

/* IMPORTANT TEXT */

.important-box p,
.important-box a,
.important-box li{
    font-size:9pt !important;
    line-height:1 !important;
    margin:0 !important;
    padding:0 !important;
    color:#333;
}

/* LIST */

.important-box ul{
    margin:0 !important;
    padding-left:14px !important;
}

.important-box li{
    margin-bottom:2px !important;
}

/* =====================================================
   RIGHT PANEL
===================================================== */

.library-box,
.assistant-box{
    border:1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius:8px;
    background:#fff;
    margin-bottom:20px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
}

/* TITLE */

.box-title{
    background:#003b8e;
    color:white;
    padding:10px;
    font-size:14pt !important;
    font-weight:bold;
}

/* TABLE */

.timing-table{
    width:100%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
}

.timing-table th,
.timing-table td{
    border:1px solid #ddd;
    padding:8px;
    text-align:center;
    font-size:12pt !important;
    line-height:1.1 !important;
}

.timing-table th{
    background:#f4f4f4;
}

/* =====================================================
   ASSISTANT SECTION
===================================================== */

.assistant-content{
    padding:12px;
}

/* BUTTON GROUP */

.button-group{
    display:flex;
    flex-wrap:wrap;
    gap:8px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
}

.button-group button{
    background:#eef3ff;
    border:1px solid #c8d7ff;
    border-radius:6px;
    padding:6px 10px;
    cursor:pointer;
    font-size:12pt !important;
    line-height:1 !important;
}

.button-group button:hover{
    background:#dce8ff;
}

/* TEXTAREA */

.assistant-content textarea{
    width:100%;
    height:70px;
    border-radius:6px;
    border:1px solid #ccc;
    padding:10px;
    resize:none;
    margin-bottom:10px;
    font-size:12pt !important;
    line-height:1.2 !important;
}

/* SEND BUTTON */

.send-btn{
    width:100%;
    background:green;
    color:white;
    border:none;
    padding:10px;
    border-radius:6px;
    font-size:12pt !important;
    cursor:pointer;
}

.send-btn:hover{
    background:darkgreen;
}

/* =====================================================
   RESPONSIVE FIX
===================================================== */

@media(max-width:991px){

    .quick-item{
        font-size:11pt !important;
    }

    .important-box p,
    .important-box a,
    .important-box li{
        font-size:8.5pt !important;
    }
}

@media(max-width:768px){

    .quick-item{
        padding:8px 10px !important;
        font-size:10pt !important;
    }

    .button-group{
        flex-direction:column;
    }

    .button-group button{
        width:100%;
    }

    .timing-table td,
    .timing-table th{
        font-size:10pt !important;
    }
}

/* Remove background color from search section */
#opac-main-search {
    background: transparent !important;
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    margin-top: -130px !important;   /* shift upward */
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
}

/* Remove inner background */
#wrap {
    background: transparent !important;
}

/* Adjust search bar container */
.main {
    background: transparent !important;
}

/* Optional: make search area floating cleanly */
.searchbox {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85) !important;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 10px;
}

/* Remove grey strip */
#moresearches {
    background: transparent !important;
    border: none !important;
}


#translControl1::placeholder{
    color:#1d2f6f;
    font-size:20px;
    font-weight:500;
    opacity:1;
}



/* Only Home button */
li#opac-main-search a {
    background-color: #0056b3 !important;
    color: white !important;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
}

li#opac-main-search a:hover {
    background-color: #003d82 !important;
}





#voiceSearchBtn{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    width:38px;
    height:38px;
    margin-left:8px;
    border:none;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:#0d6efd;
    color:#fff;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:all 0.3s ease;
    vertical-align:middle;
    box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
}

#voiceSearchBtn:hover{
    background:#0b5ed7;
    transform:scale(1.05);
}

#voiceSearchBtn.listening{
    background:#dc3545;
    animation:pulse 1s infinite;
}

@keyframes pulse{
    0%{
        transform:scale(1);
    }
    50%{
        transform:scale(1.12);
    }
    100%{
        transform:scale(1);
    }
}

/* Align search input and mic button */
#moresearches {
    margin-top: -45px !important;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
    padding: 12px 20px !important;
    width: 96% !important;
    display: block !important;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

#moresearches ul {
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
}

#moresearches a {
    color: #003b8e !important;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-decoration: none;
}

#moresearches a:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
}


.navbar,
.navbar-inner,
#members {
    background: #003b8e !important;
    border: none !important;
}

.navbar a,
#members a {
    color: white !important;
}

.navbar a:hover,
#members a:hover {
    color: #ffd54f !important;
}




.breadcrumb,
.breadcrumb li,
#breadcrumbs {
    margin-top: -15px !important;
}

/* Home button style */
.breadcrumb li:first-child a,
#breadcrumbs a {
    background: #003b8e !important;
    color: white !important;
    padding: 8px 15px !important;
    border-radius: 5px !important;

}

/* Hover effect */
.breadcrumb li:first-child a:hover,
#breadcrumbs a:hover {

}






#opaccredits,
footer {
    padding-top: 10px !important;

}

/* Footer boxes */
#opaccredits .card,
#opaccredits .col-md-4,
#opaccredits .footer-box {

    margin-bottom: 3px !important;
}

/* Reduce text spacing */
#opaccredits p,
#opaccredits h3,
#opaccredits h4,
#opaccredits li {

}

/* Bottom copyright area */
#opaccredits .copyright,
footer .copyright {

}
